title: Gallery
summary: Photo Gallery for editing, and managing photos and videos.
description:
Gallery app, your solution for managing, organizing, and safeguarding your precious memories. This feature-rich app is designed to cater to all your photo and video management needs, offering a seamless and intuitive user experience.

Gallery photo album, photo editor, manage your pictures, videos and other files

A simple, fast and light gallery for your Android Phone, you can review all your special moments in it.

Gallery - Photo Gallery & Album is a simple gallery app for Android with a picture manager, photo editor, and video player tools.

Photo Album Gallery Features:
- Import from Camera Roll
- Save to Camera Roll
- Rename, Delete, Details
- Share on social media
- Photo Editor
- In-Built video player
- Recently added Feature
- Add to favorite photos
- WhatsApp status saver

🌄 All-in-one photo gallery
With Gallery, you can easily view files in all formats: JPEG, PNG, Panorama, MP4, MKV, RAW, etc. It also supports playing photos as a slideshow.

🎨 Photo Editing Tools:
Transform your images with our built-in editor. Crop, rotate, and add stunning filters to make your photos pop.

🔍 Advanced Search & Filters:
Find any photo or video instantly. Save time and relive your moments faster.

📂 Flexible File Support:
Supports popular formats like JPEG, PNG, GIF, RAW, MP4, and more. No need for additional apps—manage everything in one place!

📌 Favorites Section:
Mark and access your favorite photos and videos instantly. Keep your cherished memories just a tap away.

📤 Instant Sharing:
Share your memories with ease! Send photos and videos directly through messaging apps.

💾 Offline Access:
Enjoy full functionality even when offline. Your memories are always accessible, anytime, anywhere.

📱 Multi-Language Support:
Explore the app in your preferred language. Gallery supports multiple languages to make your experience global and personal.

Thank you for choosing Gallery - photo gallery, album! Let’s create and cherish memories together!❤️📸
